task: offline retrospective hourly long-horizon anomaly detection

sustained_overload.description_ko: 3~6일 동안 시간당 요청 수가 평소보다 많음

sustained_input_drop.description_ko: 3~6일 동안 수집은 정상인데 시간당 입력이 줄어듦

daily_pattern_change.description_ko: 7일 동안 평소와 다른 하루 주기의 요청 패턴이 반복됨

evaluation.unit: one observed hour in the 14-day monitoring horizon
evaluation.threshold_selection: normal calibration and development only; one frozen threshold per model
evaluation.test_usage: once after model selection; read-only report thereafter

limitations: These are custom semi-synthetic long sequences, not an official ADBench dataset.
Synthetic AR continuity is assumed; gaps between real exports are never filled as real traffic zeros.
Success status is a normal candidate filter, not proof of operational normality.
Retrospective scores may use later hours within the supplied monitoring batch.
Event parameters and labels are not detector inputs.
